correctness.rationale: PASS. Independently implemented a separate Fraction-based exact finite certificate after reading pinned verify_voronoi.py. Enumerated the complete two-coset nonzero site cutoff q(s)<=54/25: 74 sites in shells 18,16,16,24. Solved all 792 five-constraint chamber candidates: 455 nonsingular, exactly 41 feasible vertices, all with q<=27/50 and satisfying 74 true bisectors. Since any farther site has norm >2sqrt(27/50), the triangle inequality eliminates it on P, so this finite check covers the infinite point set. Six true chamber vertices have five linearly independent active genuine bisectors. Their 384 signed-permutation orbit gives exactly 864 simple V vertices, split 576 at 27/50 and 288 at 481/900. Independently enumerated tight site-index subsets to recover f-vector (864,2160,1872,648,74), affine rank-4 facet support for all 74 facets, and exact site-coordinate determinants ±1 or ±1/2 at the two shells. Double counting six site incidences per Delaunay simplex across two sites per D5 period yields 192+96 simplices and volume fractions 4/5+1/5. All arithmetic exact rational; the cutoff and symmetry justify exhaustive extension.
